hero.title: Driven red-legged partridge
hero.subtitle: Pegs, beaters and bags of 250, 400 or 600 birds in Campos de Montiel.

intro: Driven days are one of the disciplines at La Calerilla. Minimum 6 pegs. Bags of 250, 400 or 600 birds, three shots per partridge. The peg may be shared or individual.
includes: Hunting equipment: bird rails, screens and peg markers
A peg of 10 partridges per gun (can be delivered plucked)
Bungalow Suite with breakfast, field snack, lunch and dinner
notes: TODO_DATO: languages spoken by the team.

jornada.transcript: A driven day at La Calerilla: beaters moving through the ground, guns on pegs among cereal and holm oaks, and coveys of red-legged partridge.
